description: Guides comorbidity-stratified selection of initial and further glucose-lowering medicines for adults with type 2 diabetes using the NICE NG28 (2026) framework, covering six clinical profiles: no relevant comorbidity, heart failure, atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, early onset, obesity, chronic kidney disease, and frailty.
